Title: Are you familiar with the concept of a Personal Board of Directors?
Detail: A PBOD consists of 5-7 trusted relationships that guide your professional growth - like a CEO has a board, so should you

Title: How would you rate your current professional support network?
Detail: Think about the quality and diversity of guidance you receive

Title: Who in your network serves as your PEER - someone at your level who provides accountability and a safe space to share challenges?
Detail: A peer understands your day-to-day reality and provides mutual support

Title: What kind of peer support do you most need right now?
Who serves as your MENTOR - someone with wisdom and lived experience who helps you see patterns?
Detail: A mentor has walked your path before and provides perspective

Title: What area of mentorship would benefit you most?
Who is your CHAMPION/SPONSOR - someone who opens doors and advocates for you in rooms you're not in?
Detail: A champion actively promotes your interests and creates opportunities

Title: How comfortable are you with having someone advocate for you?
Detail: Many people struggle with this - it's not self-promotion, it's strategic support

Title: What type of SPECIALIST ADVISOR would most accelerate your growth?
Detail: Specialists provide niche expertise in specific areas

Title: What specific expertise gap is holding you back?
Detail: Be as specific as possible about the knowledge or skills you need

Title: Who in your life plays devil's advocate and sharpens your thinking?
Detail: A challenger questions your assumptions and pushes you to think deeper

Title: How well do you handle constructive challenge to your ideas?
Detail: Growth requires being open to different perspectives

Title: Are you currently mentoring someone?
Detail: Being a mentee on someone else's board helps you reflect and crystallize your own learning

Title: Which PBOD role is most missing from your current network?
What's one concrete action you'll take this week to strengthen your Personal Board of Directors?
Detail: Examples: Reach out to a potential mentor, schedule coffee with a peer, identify a specialist you need
